info.title: PTV Open Api version 11
info.description:
# ⚠️ Important information The PTV architecture is currently being redesigned, with the release of API version 12 in 2026. **🚀 The new version is significantly different from version 11.** Take this change into account when planning a new integration! 👉 [More Information](https://kehittajille.suomi.fi/palvelut/palvelutietovaranto/rajapinta-ja-arkkitehtuuriuudistus)

Listed below are the GET methods you can use to fetch data from PTV (OUT interface) and the POST and PUT for bringing data to PTV from an external data source (IN interface). Using POST and PUT methods requires API access rights.

post.summary: This method creates a connection between one or several services and one or several service channels and, if necessary, adds additional connection details to the connection.

requestBody.description: A list of services and service channels.

put.summary:
This method updates connections between one service and one or several service channels with the connection details (optional).
Previously posted connections that are missing from the request are removed.
However, ASTI connections are left as they are. To delete connections, set 'deleteAllChannelRelations' property to true.

post.summary: This method creates connections between one or several services and one or several service channels with connection details. External source id:s are used.

requestBody.description: A list of services and service channels.

put.summary:
This method updates the connections between a service and one or several service channels with the connection details.
External source ids are used. Previously posted connections that are missing from the request are removed.
To delete all the service channel connections for a service set 'deleteAllChannelRelations' property to true.
ASTI connections are not removed – the data for those connections can be updated though.

This method updates connections between a service and one or several ASTI service channels with connection details.
Previously posted ASTI connections that are missing from this request are removed. Other than ASTI connections are left as they are.
To delete all the ASTI service channel connections for a service, set 'deleteAllChannelRelations' property to true.
NOTE! This is a restricted endpoint for ASTI users only.

This method updates connections between a service and one or several ASTI service channel(s) with connection details. External source ids are used.
Previously posted ASTI connections that are missing from this request are removed. Other than ASTI connections are left as they are.
To delete all ASTI service channel connections for a service, set 'deleteAllChannelRelations' property to true.
NOTE! This is a restricted endpoint for ASTI users only.

This method updates the connections between a service channel and one or several services with the connection details.
Previously posted ASTI connections that are missing from this request are removed. Other than ASTI connections are left as they are.
To delete all the ASTI connections for a service channel set 'deleteAllServiceRelations' property to true.
NOTE! This is a restricted endpoint for ASTI users only.
